meta.name: Cat Lady: Secret Favourites (Balanced)
meta.blurb: Draft 2-card lots of food, cats, strays, toys and catnip from a public market, then score with a secret Favourite bonus.

setup.label: your favourite
setup.text: Your secret Favourite is {favourite}. Only you know it until final scoring.

rules:
The deck has {deck_size} cards: {food1_cards} Food-1 ({food1_value} food each), {food2_cards} Food-2 ({food2_value} food each), {cat_cards} Cat, {stray_cards} Stray Cat, {toy_cards_total} Toy ({toy_cards_per_colour} Red, {toy_cards_per_colour} Blue, {toy_cards_per_colour} Green) and {catnip_cards} Catnip. The deck is shuffled once.

Each player is secretly dealt one Favourite, and every player gets a different one. With 3 players the Favourites are drawn from {Cats, Toys, Catnip}; with 4 players from {Cats, Toys, Catnip, Strays}. Only the owner knows their Favourite. Players sit in a fixed order, seat 1 to seat N.

With 3 players there are {rounds_with_3_players} rounds; with 4 players there are {rounds_with_4_players}. In round r, the first picker is seat ((r-1) mod N) + 1, and the others follow in seat order, wrapping from the last seat to seat 1. Every seat holds each picking position equally often: {picks_per_position_3_players} times each with 3 players, {picks_per_position_4_players} times each with 4 players.

Each round:
1. The market is dealt from the top of the deck. With 3 players, {lots_with_3_players} lots (Lot A to Lot D) of {cards_per_lot} cards each; with 4 players, {lots_with_4_players} lots (Lot A to Lot E) of {cards_per_lot} cards each. Every lot's contents are announced to all players.
2. Starting with the first picker, each player in turn chooses one remaining lot by its letter. You are offered only lots nobody has picked yet this round. Everyone sees all earlier picks.
3. A chosen lot goes to that player at once. Food cards add their food value to your food total. Cats, Strays, Toys (by colour) and Catnip are added to your counts. Everything you own is public, except your Favourite.
4. When every player has picked, the one leftover lot is discarded.
5. After the last round comes final scoring. With 4 players, the {unused_deck_cards_4_players} cards still in the deck are never used; with 3 players the deck is used up exactly.

Final scoring, for each player:
- Feeding: each Cat needs {food_per_cat} food. Fed cats = the smaller of (Cats) and (food / 2, rounded down). Each fed cat scores {fed_cat_points} and each unfed Cat scores {unfed_cat_points}. Leftover food = food total - 2 x fed cats.
- Strays: each Stray Cat scores {stray_points}.
- Toys: each Toy scores {toy_points}, plus {toy_set_points} for each complete set of one Red, one Blue and one Green. Number of sets = the smallest of the three colour counts.
- Catnip: with n Catnip cards, counting at most {catnip_count_cap}, you score n(n+1)/2 (maximum {catnip_max_points}). Catnip beyond {catnip_count_cap} scores nothing here.
- Food penalty: the player or players with the most leftover food lose {food_penalty} points, provided that amount is at least {food_penalty_min_leftover}. If the most leftover food at the table is 0, nobody loses points.
- Favourite bonus, revealed now: Cats: +{fav_cats_per_fed_cat} per fed cat, maximum +{fav_cats_max}. Toys: +{fav_toys_per_toy} per Toy card. Catnip: +{fav_catnip_per_card} per Catnip card owned (including any beyond {catnip_count_cap}), maximum +{fav_catnip_max}. Strays (4 players only): +{fav_strays_per_stray} per Stray Cat.

The highest final total wins. If players are tied, the tied player with the most fed cats wins. If they are still tied, those players draw and share the win.
